name: timesheet
description: Tracks the time you spend working with Claude, per repo, for timesheets and billing: a status line, a pane, /time reports and CSV export, synced across machines and cloud sessions.

idleMinutes.title: Idle after (minutes)
idleMinutes.description: A gap longer than this between your activity ends a block of tracked time

roundTo.title: Round up to (minutes)
roundTo.description: Rounds each project's time per day up to this increment in reports and exports, e.g. 6 for tenths of an hour; 0 leaves it exact

rate.title: Hourly rate
rate.description: Shows an amount beside each project's hours in reports; 0 hides it

exportDir.title: Export folder
exportDir.description: Where /time export writes its CSV; ~ is your home folder

syncRepo.title: Sync repository
syncRepo.description: A private GitHub repository (owner/name) each session's time is pushed to and read back from, so cloud sessions and other machines count; empty keeps time on this machine only

githubToken.title: GitHub token
githubToken.description: A token with read and write access to the sync repository's contents. Left empty, the mod uses the TIMESHEET_GITHUB_TOKEN variable, then gh auth token

describe.title: Describe the work
describe.description: Has /time export write a client-ready description per project per day from a one-line note of each prompt (one small model call per project); off leaves that column empty
